title: 28.10. REPAIR Dialogues with Antti Paakkari
content:
Antti Paakkari (Tampere University) will give an online presentation titled Living with data: Parents negotiating invisible data labour in childhood institutions on October 28 9:00-10:00 (EET).

Attend the session via Zoom: https://helsinki.zoom.us/j/5176679542

REPAIR Dialogues is an informal online series where researchers and collaborators from the REPAIR project share their ongoing work, ideas, and findings. Each session features a short presentation followed by an open discussion. All are welcome!
